study type: Retrospective review for nomogram development (case-control like design)
cohort: The study included 230 neonates (115 with CMBs and 115 sex-matched healthy controls) treated at The First Hospital of Tsinghua University.
finding: A nomogram based on spontaneous delivery, neonatal pneumonia, gestational hypertension, and gestational diabetes could effectively predict the occurrence of neonatal CMBs, with ischemic infarction being an independent risk factor for moderate-to-severe CMBs.
mod_finding: Spontaneous delivery was identified as an independent risk factor for neonatal CMBs (OR = 7.88; 95% CI: 3.27-19.00; P<0.001).
cross-section timing: N/A (data collected included 'days after birth' at the time of MRI diagnosis in the neonatal period)
birth_weight: Measured as a variable in the study.
gest_age: Measured as a variable in the study.
